threshold_note: Numeric thresholds are tunable coach heuristics, not sourced game rules. Camp availability and enemy cooldowns are not inferred from absence.

cards.speech: Secure last hits and denies. Do not trade away your wave income.
cards.rationale: Lane income takes priority over low-value harassment.

sources.excerpt: safe last hits and denies over risky harass

cards.speech: {lane} is pushing toward you. Catch that wave from cover before taking camps.
cards.rationale: Protect lane income before spending time on a neutral camp.

sources.excerpt: Clearing a Trooper wave is generally faster and pays more than a camp, so camp between waves

cards.speech: More enemy markers are near you. Hold your side and protect your last hits.
cards.rationale: A visible local numbers disadvantage favors a defensive wave position.

sources.excerpt: 1v2: stop pushing, hold wave near own side, give up denies, don't die

cards.speech: Health looks low or falling. Back behind cover before trading.
cards.rationale: Preserve health and lane uptime instead of taking another low-value trade.

sources.excerpt: Don't trade unless it wins you a last hit or a kill. Back off and farm.

cards.speech: You are ahead of your trooper wave. Step back behind it before trading.
cards.rationale: Do not expose yourself ahead of wave cover while an enemy marker is nearby.

sources.excerpt: Troopers deal deceptively high damage if you overextend

cards.speech: Clear the {lane} wave first. Crash it before leaving, and stay behind your troopers.
cards.rationale: Wave priority creates the window to rotate without sacrificing lane income.

cards.speech: Your wave has the numbers. Take a short poke from cover between last hits.
cards.rationale: Use wave cover for a short trade without giving up farm or assuming enemy cooldowns.

sources.excerpt: peeking from the right side of cover exposes less than left

cards.speech: {lane} looks pushed. Check one nearby camp if it is up, then return to the wave.
cards.rationale: A crashed wave can create a short farming window; actual camp availability remains unknown.

sources.excerpt: Push first, then camp, return as waves clash
Don't be farming when your team is grouping for Midboss/Rift/Urn/push

cards.speech: Your wave is pushed. Spend your souls, then return before the next wave.
cards.rationale: Use a wave window to convert unspent currency into usable power.

sources.excerpt: Crash wave then shop, then return

cards.speech: An objective is approaching. Clear your wave before rotating.
cards.rationale: Prepare lane priority before leaving for a scheduled objective.

sources.excerpt: Clear your wave first, then go to the objective

cards.speech: Your wave is pushed. Look to group for the objective instead of starting another camp.
cards.rationale: Use lane priority to prepare an objective rotation rather than delaying for extra farm.

sources.excerpt: Don't be farming when your team is grouping for Midboss/Rift/Urn/push
